summary: Multi-shop CRM: comprehensive isolation + authorization tests. 20/20 pytest cases pass covering shop creation with distinct codes, same-email across shops, shop-scoped login (DEMO01, A/B, wrong password 401, nonexistent shop 401), seed defaults (5 services, 3 plans, 0 barbers for new shops), cross-shop authorization 404s for PUT/DELETE on barbers/services/plans + PATCH status/DELETE on appointments, booking conflict 409 with availability flipping to available=false, client isolation (list/loyalty/redeem), scoped dashboard + barber reports, and cron reminders (401 without auth, 200 with Bearer secret returning {date,due,sent}). Frontend login/create-shop/admin flows validated: shop-code-input, go-register-btn, go-create-shop-btn present; create-shop flow generated code (e.g., KD0FLE) in new-shop-code and redirected to /dashboard; DEMO01 admin login shows shop-code-badge 'Código: DEMO01'; invalid shop code displays 'Barbearia, e-mail ou senha inválidos' toast and stays on login.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~855 lines in one file — consider splitting into routers/modules (auth, barbers, services, appointments, clients, plans, subscriptions, dashboard, cron) if growth continues.

List endpoints return raw doc fields via dict-spread (barbers/services/plans/subscriptions). password_hash is NOT a risk here because those collections don't store it, but if any extra field is added later it will leak. Prefer explicit response models.

pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope which breaks cross-class state sharing in multi-shop tests; test_multi_shop.py has to be run with -n 0 for sequential ordering. Document this or convert tests to be fully self-contained per class.
serialize_user does not include password_hash (good). get_current_user accepts cookie-less Bearer only — login does not set httpOnly cookie, so the frontend keeps JWT in localStorage (XSS risk).

seed_data_creation: Created ad-hoc TEST shops, barbers, services, plans, clients, and appointments via API during tests. Shops persist in DB as TEST Barbearia A/B etc. — safe to prune by shop_name LIKE 'TEST %'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully validated for multi-shop isolation and cross-shop 404s. Run tests with: `python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_multi_shop.py -n 0 -v`. Frontend login + create-shop + admin badge verified; UI panels (Agendamentos/Barbeiros/Clientes/Fidelizados/Planos/Relatórios) rely on same scoped APIs already proven at the API layer. If deeper UI testing is required, use data-testids: nav-*-tab, new-appointment-btn, booking-* , add-barber-btn, etc. Emails do not send (RESEND_API_KEY empty) — expected, not a bug.
